summary: Clearwater NF ground site in Idaho County, ID; a log cabin with cupola built in 1922, destroyed at an undated later time, and listed as gone.

facts.status_note: Destroyed sometime after 1922; no date given in the sources read

notes_for_editor: Construction year 1922 agrees across firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts, the Clearwater NF post and the Montana photo caption. Destruction date and cause are not given anywhere read. Record county 'Idaho' matches the source's 'Idaho County, Idaho'; no correction. Two 1922 photo leads were found but not fetched for image URLs, so no photos entry: Montana History Portal (Bud Moore collection, under construction 1922) and University of Idaho Selway-Bitterroot item sbw106 (Howard R. Flint, 1922, public domain). The Clearwater NF post also speculates about a 1932 ranger trip; that is not used because it is not documented.
